items.html: And the aspect of the sparks requires a wide explanation, and it depends on the discourse of the 288 sparks, which was clarified above, where it was clarified that the 288 are four Names: AB, SAG, MA, BON — 72 sparks from each one. And behold, the GAR, which are AB, SAG, MA, are in ZA alone, as above, for they are the phase of Hesed of AB, Gevura of SAG, and Tifferet and NHY of MA. But BON is in the Nukva of ZA. And understand this introduction well. And it is found that these three Names, AB, SAG, MA, are sparks that entered these vessels of ZA to give him life. And afterwards we will clarify the matter of the Nukva, with the help of God.
